evidence: Proteome screen UP000006672 (15,168 entries), GGGTGSG + beta N-terminal motif
claim: How many beta-tubulin isotypes B. malayi has
finding: Exactly four: Bm4733/bma-ben-1, Bm9698, Bm8661, Bm12766. Q66T51 is not a fifth gene.

evidence: Needleman-Wunsch global alignment, BLOSUM62, gap -11/-1, 16 sequences
claim: bma-ben-1 is the Brugia isotype closest to C. elegans BEN-1
finding: 93.69% vs 89.86/88.69/87.61%; margin 3.83 pp; reciprocal best hit
confidence: high for ranking; UPGMA does not resolve 1:1 orthology

evidence: Residue inventory at Q134/S165/F167/E198/F200/M257 mapped to H. contortus isotype-1 numbering
claim: Sequence at resistance codons can discriminate the Brugia isotypes
finding: All four carry Q134, F167, E198, F200, M257. Only residue 165 varies (S/S/N/T).
context: in silico; positive control Cel TBB-1/TBB-2 Y200, MEC-7 S198, TBB-6 C167

claim: Filarial beta-tubulins lack the resistance-associated substitutions
finding: Predicted that filarial beta-tubulin sequence would not distinguish BZ susceptibility

claim: The cloned Brugia beta-tubulin is the ben-1-clade member
finding: 94% to ben-1, 90% to tub-1, 88% to mec-7 for the B. pahangi gene; same isoform pattern in adults and microfilariae

evidence: AY705382 / PMID 16103581; O. volvulus genotyping PMID 16197589, PMID 22677339
claim: The gene used in filarial BZ-resistance genotyping is this locus
finding: AY705382 is 99.8% identical to bma-ben-1 and 85-88% to the other three; O. volvulus/D. immitis genes are 98.4% identical to bma-ben-1

evidence: UniProt protein-existence levels; 8-mer assignment of 70 NCBI tubulin records
claim: Expression can exclude or favour an isotype
finding: All four PE=3; all four have assigned records (4/2/2/2); only bma-ben-1 has an independent cDNA (Q66T51, PE=2)
confidence: moderate; not a quantitative expression measure

evidence: EBI Expression Atlas; WormBase ParaSite REST
claim: Isotype-resolved stage expression is programmatically available
finding: Atlas holds 0 Brugia experiments; ParaSite REST timed out on three attempts. No per-isotype expression matrix obtained.
confidence: stated as a negative result, not an inference

claim: Loss of the ben-1-clade isotype confers BZ resistance in a nematode
finding: ben-1 deletion gives BZ resistance in C. elegans
confidence: high in C. elegans, not transferable to B. malayi without test

evidence: Absence of any B. malayi functional test
claim: The B. malayi BZ target isotype has been identified functionally
finding: No B. malayi loss-of-function, RNAi or allele-swap experiment has tested any isotype against flubendazole or oxfendazole
confidence: high; this is the reason the verdict stays unresolved
